evaluatorConstraints: Readonly access to all three run repos
Must inspect raw artifacts, not summaries
Must not trust codex self-mapping of quality
Must apply same product rubric to all three runs
Must record defects with evidence paths
Must not force multi-agent win or loss
independenceChecks: Evaluator has no prior knowledge of expected winner
Evaluator score sheets are timestamped before comparison
Evaluator evidence is independently verifiable by third party
